roles.name: Mission Lead
roles.job: Keeps the mission on budget. Picks the spacecraft body, the rocket and the launch date.
roles.goal: Keep at least {need} of the budget unspent
roles.why: Real missions keep money in reserve. Surprises always cost something.

roles.name: Spacecraft Engineer
roles.job: Keeps the spacecraft alive. Picks the power source, the engine and the fuel.
roles.goal: Make at least {need} more power than the spacecraft uses
roles.why: Spare power (a power margin) keeps the spacecraft running when panels get dusty or parts get old.

roles.name: Science Lead
roles.job: Wants the best science. Picks the instruments.
roles.why: Science is why the mission exists. But every instrument adds mass, power, cost and data.

roles.name: Communications Lead
roles.job: Gets the data home. Picks the antenna.
roles.goal: Send at least {need} of the science data back to Earth
roles.why: Science that never reaches Earth is lost. A bigger antenna sends more, but it is heavier and needs more power.

text.setupLead: Up to four people share one screen. Each person gets a job and a goal. The goals pull against each other, so you will have to talk it out.
text.panelHint: A goal can be met in many ways. There is no single right spacecraft.
text.signoffHint: Real mission teams only launch when every lead says "go". If anyone changes the design, everyone has to agree again.
text.yourCallHint: Talk with your team, but {name} has the final say.
text.teamScore: Team score {total}: mission score {score} + {bonus} for team goals
text.allMet: Every team goal met! +{bonus} bonus for working together.
